market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil above $100 and inflation data support Fed hike, pressuring equities and bonds simultaneously. 4th straight day of losses suggests capitulation risk but also continued downside. S&P 500 breaking 50-day MA is technically bearish. Expect elevated volatility (VIX 25+) through Fed decision. Oil could test $110-115 if Houthi attacks escalate. Bond yields likely to grind higher on GPIF selling and Bessent buyback failure.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle (Qualcomm, Credo, GitLab) supports tech earnings through 2027. Energy transition overcapacity will normalize by 2027. India and EM capital flows positive. However, sustained 7%+ mortgage rates and consumer squeeze could delay cyclical recovery. Fed hiking cycle likely 1-2 more moves before pause. Geopolitical normalization (Iran) would be major positive catalyst.
